description: Deterministic defaults for AFKAF Prompt Topology Classifier. Same source + same config + same embedding responses => byte-identical outputs. Random seeds are mandatory.

feature_views.note: V1 starts from metadata already owned by registry. Derived flags (requires_mutation, is_meta_prompt, etc.) are intentionally deferred until validated signal proves value.

similarity.metadata_similarity: cosine(structured_one_hot(A), structured_one_hot(B)) where categoricals are one-hot, binaries are 0/1, then L2-normalized
similarity.storage: in-repo JSON artifact, brute-force O(n^2) (40k comparisons for n=200, trivial)
similarity.reason: Avoid introducing Pinecone/Qdrant/Weaviate as side quest for current corpus size.

neighbors.asymmetry_detection: Flag when A ranks B in top-3 but B does not rank A in top-10 — indicates bridge prompt.

clustering.why_not_kmeans: Unknown k, variable sizes, legitimate outliers, coexisting dense/sparse families, UNKNOWN is desirable.
clustering.input: semantic_embedding (or composite reduced space) — never the 3D projection coordinates

reduction.alternative_v1_simple: PCA 30-50D directly into HDBSCAN; add UMAP 10-15D only if corpus proves it needs it.

cluster_id_policy.formula: C- + first 6 hex chars of SHA256(sorted(member_prompt_ids) joined by ',') uppercase
cluster_id_policy.stable: If membership materially changes, identity changes — useful evidence.
cluster_id_policy.forbidden: Do not use raw HDBSCAN label integer as permanent identity.

family_assignment.method: weighted majority of member declared_families within cluster
family_assignment.ambiguous_when: No family reaches >=0.60 of members => AMBIGUOUS_CLUSTER, family_candidate=null
family_assignment.example_high: C-18C5A7: 7/8 repository-operations => candidate repository-operations, confidence high

per_prompt_alignment.AMBIGUOUS: inferred_family is null (cluster has no majority)

states.AMBIGUOUS: cluster has no majority (independent of score)

duplicate_detection.note: Similarity thresholds produce review candidates, not automatic duplicate declarations. AFKAF must surface evidence list.

projection_3d.why_umap_not_pca: Local neighborhoods matter more than global linear variance for visualization.
projection_3d.input: semantic_embedding (or composite vectors) — never cluster labels
projection_3d.visualization_only: 3D coordinates must never determine semantic classification. Deleting and regenerating projection must not change clusters or classifications.

shapes.description: Enveloping shapes downstream of projection, visualization metadata only.
shapes.not_classification: Shape correctness never blocks classifier correctness.

ordering.principle: Stable IDs, derived placement. Prompt IDs never mutated. Generated kit order is presentational manifest derived from topology.
ordering.family_order_rationale: Lifecycle dependency order: establish context (Foundation), orient (Discover & Plan), mutate (Build & Repair), prove (Validate & Protect), move (Integrate & Ship), automate (Autonomy). Mirrors registry/prompts/prompt-classification.v1.json section ids and harness/workflows.v1.json progression. Any declared family not in this list (e.g. future extension) sorts after autonomy, lexicographically, before outliers.

cluster_order_within_family.tie_break: member_count descending puts most representative (largest) cluster first; cluster_id lexicographic (C-XXXXXX) gives total stability for equal sizes.
cluster_order_within_family.alternative_considered_and_rejected: Sorting by centroid 3D position would couple ordering to stochastic projection — rejected.
cluster_order_within_family.outlier_position: OUTLIER bucket always last within its family group, after all real clusters.

sprint_role_order.description: Tertiary ordering within each cluster before centrality.
sprint_role_order.fallback: Any prompt type not in this explicit list sorts lexicographically after all listed types (ASCII ascending), then by seq_int.
sprint_role_order.rationale: Orders workflow positions from setup through closeout; keeps BUILD before VALIDATE before INTEGRATE, matching sprint lifecycle. Lexicographic fallback guarantees total order even for future types without requiring config amendment to remain deterministic.

intra_cluster_order.key: Within each (family, cluster) bucket, sort prompts by (role_rank, -centrality, seq_int, prompt_id)
intra_cluster_order.role_rank: index in sprint_role_order (lower = earlier); unlisted types sort after listed, lexicographically.
intra_cluster_order.centrality: average composite similarity(P, every member of same cluster) — higher first, so most representative prompt leads the cluster. Rounded to 4 decimals; ties broken by seq_int then prompt_id.
intra_cluster_order.centrality_formula: centrality(P) = mean_{Q in cluster} score(P,Q) where score is composite similarity (0.70*semantic+0.20*role+0.10*metadata).
intra_cluster_order.outlier_centrality: null => treated as -inf, so outliers sort after clustered prompts within same family bucket, then by role_rank then seq_int.
intra_cluster_order.deterministic_tie_break: prompt_id lexicographic (P sort) is final tie-break; ensures total order is strict and stable across runs.

ordering.linear_order_construction: linear_order = flatten(groups in family_order) where each group = flatten(clusters sorted by cluster_order) where each cluster = prompts sorted by intra_cluster key. Outliers group (family_id=outliers, cluster_id=OUTLIER) appended after all real families.
ordering.kits_order_output: artifacts/prompt-topology/kit-order.json with {groups:[{family,family_id,clusters:[{cluster_id,prompts}]}], linear_order:[P-IDs in total deterministic order], outliers_group}
ordering.source_vs_derived_boundary: Generated kit presentation may use linear_order for discovery, but web/prompt-kit/index.html canonical library order remains sequence_ascending per harness/contracts/prompt-kit-order-navigation.v1.json. Topology order is discoveryRank-style recommendation metadata, never a silent replacement of stable sequence.

artifact_tree.orchestrator: python scripts/prompt-topology/run.py [--provider openai|local] [--check] runs whole pipeline; no hand-running seven scripts to get valid state.
artifact_tree.disposability_test: rm -rf artifacts/prompt-topology/* && python scripts/prompt-topology/run.py must reconstruct identical derived state (given same embedding responses).

thresholds.semantic_warnings_permitted: unbounded but surfaced; AFKAF blocks new prompt with POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE (>=0.94 composite and high role similarity) until explicit disposition (STRENGTHEN vs CREATE_NEW) is recorded.
thresholds.new_prompt_gate: Proposed prompt with composite>=0.94 and role>=0.88 and same sprint_path_role => fail contribution gate, require STRENGTHEN disposition.

incremental_rebuild.reuse: unchanged prompt => reuse embedding; changed prompt => regenerate; neighbors and clustering always recompute globally.

stack_v1.vector_storage: JSON artifact (or compact binary) — no vector DB
stack_v1.validation: existing harness pattern (JSON validator + python -m unittest)
